title: 上海高考翻译背诵-75-25一模

items.zh: 面对不公,他毫不犹豫地挺身而出,捍卫正义。
items.en: Faced with injustice, he didn’t hesitate to stand up for justice.

items.zh: 她极有绘画天赋,不知接下来会有何等佳作面世。
items.en: She has an extraordinary talent for painting, and there is no telling what masterpieces will appear next.

items.zh: 设计师将可持续理念融入历史建筑的修缮,既确保了该建筑符合环保要求,又保留其文化底蕴。
items.en: The designer integrates the concept of sustainability into the restoration of the historical building, not only ensuring that the building meets environmental standards, but also preserving its cultural heritage.

items.zh: 在90年代,这种疾病因其复杂性,曾被误诊为流感类疾病,如今人们已经认识到它是一种罕见的精神障碍。
items.en: The disease, whose complexity led to its being misdiagnosed as flu-like illnesses in the 1990s, is now recognized as a rare mental disorder.
